stories.title: Jamia holds 'Run for Unity' and pledge ceremony on Rashtriya Ekta Diwas
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia marked the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel and Rashtriya Ekta Diwas with a pledge-taking ceremony and a 'Run for Unity' on Saturday 31 October, according to a university press release issued on Monday 2 November. The programme was organised by the Games and Sports Department at the Nawab Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi Sports Complex on campus. Vice-Chancellor Prof. Mazhar Asif read the pledge and flagged off the run at 9 am. Deans, the Chief Proctor, faculty, non-teaching staff, students and community members took part, the release says. The Vice-Chancellor urged the university community to keep the spirit of the run alive every day, and the Registrar spoke of diversity as India's strength.
stories.check: Single source, and the account is the university's own press release (6180). The release page carries no printed date; 2 November is from the PDF text. Offline classes at Jamia are still reported for Tuesday 10 November by IANS and ThePrint (30 Oct), against Monday 9 November in Amar Ujala (31 Oct); no newer official notice was found. Confirm with Jamia.
